strict_evaluated_predicate.note: status=evaluated is legal ONLY when every clause holds; otherwise status=unresolved. Unresolved rows remain in the 885 ledger but DO NOT count toward completion.

confidence_model.basis: denominator sample size (missing != zero); operator-defined target certainty
confidence_model.note: Small held-family weekly samples yield low/medium confidence honestly; a firing rule on n<15 is a low-confidence signal, not a certainty.

rating_model.note: rating compares the observed value to the operational target given the metric direction. rank is the 1..3 position of this dealer among the three rooftops for the same metric (best-first by direction).

SW-031.formula: appts_set_total / leads_total (Dealership Performance Dashboard summary TOTAL row)
SW-031.reconciliation: computed rate must equal the source 'Appts Set %' TOTAL cell within 1e-6
